title: Ricci Curvature and Betti Numbers of Hessian Manifolds
summary: We study Ricci curvature properties of Hessian metrics on the leaves of the codimension-one foliation $\mathcal{F}_ω= \ker\,ω$ generated by the first Koszul form $ω$ of a closed oriented Hessian manifold. Our main result reveals a striking rigidity phenomenon: non-negative Ricci curvature on a single leaf of $\mathcal{F}_ω$ compels the Hessian metric to be flat, yields sharp bounds on the first Betti number in terms of the dimension of the Hessian manifold and the topology of the leaves.
